description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Arid Archway
Holding priority, activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
